page.overview:
Who is Adohi-Tehga?

Adohi-Tehga is a Lizardman Slann mage-priest of the Second Spawning. He resides in the Great Temple of the Old One Tlazcotl, to whom he is devoted, in the Lustrian temple-city of Tlaxtlan. He was an impossibly old being of immense power, importance and bodily girth, and a great lunamancer and reader of the stellar signs.

Adohi-Tehga was created during the Second Spawning of Slann, and only Mazdamundi of Hexoatl was older than him.

During the Great Catastrophe, Adohi-Tehga repelled the Daemons besieging Tlaxtlan after weeks of battle, and then lent his power to protecting the remaining cities and ensuring the Geomantic Web did not collapse utterly.

At some point in the last century, he granted the Palanquin of Constellations to the Skink Chief Astromancer Tetto'eko, and taught him the incantations necessary to make it rise.
